title: Covered Component Groups and Listed Exclusions — Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
Each DriveSure plan of Vehicle Service Contracts covers a defined set of component groups. The higher plans add groups to those of the plans below them, and DriveSure Exclusionary covers all components except the listed exclusions.

## Exhibit A: component groups covered by plan

| Component group | Powertrain | Powertrain Plus | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Exclusionary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Engine | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | All components except the listed exclusions |
| Transmission | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | (as above) |
| Drive axle | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | (as above) |
| Seals and gaskets | — | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | (as above) |
| Turbocharger or supercharger | — | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | (as above) |
| Air conditioning | — | — | Covered | Covered | Covered | (as above) |
| Steering | — | — | Covered | Covered | Covered | (as above) |
| Brakes (non-wear) | — | — | Covered | Covered | Covered | (as above) |
| Electrical | — | — | — | Covered | Covered | (as above) |
| Fuel system | — | — | — | Covered | Covered | (as above) |
| Cooling system | — | — | — | Covered | Covered | (as above) |
| Suspension | — | — | — | — | Covered | (as above) |
| High-tech electronics | — | — | — | — | Covered | (as above) |
| Hybrid components | — | — | — | — | Covered | (as above) |

A dash means the group is not among that plan's covered component groups.

## Exhibit B: listed exclusions

The following items are never covered by any plan, including the exclusionary plan:

1. wear items: brake pads, rotors, wipers and tires;
2. maintenance services;
3. glass and body panels;
4. upholstery and trim;
5. aftermarket modifications;
6. damage from collision or abuse;
7. pre-existing conditions.

## Exhibit C: further coverage terms by plan

| Term | Powertrain | Powertrain Plus | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Exclusionary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seals and gaskets covered when replaced as part of a covered repair | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Failures that began before enrollment or during the waiting period excluded | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Teardown and diagnosis paid when the failure is covered | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Illustrations (hypothetical parts)

- A failed steering rack is within the covered component groups of DriveSure Silver, Gold and Platinum, is not among those of DriveSure Powertrain or Powertrain Plus, and under DriveSure Exclusionary is covered because steering is not a listed exclusion.
- Worn brake pads are a listed exclusion and are outside every plan, DriveSure Exclusionary included.
